high_level_description: stc brand style, a fisheye lens photograph of a rustic dining area ceiling with hanging lanterns.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A ceiling with colorful striped red, white, and black fabric radiating outward, bright green and yellow walls, and a dark floor, shot from a low angle with strong radial distortion.

elements.desc: Two vintage-style lanterns with warm yellow light hanging from the ceiling, casting a golden glow.
